title: Site map canvas: scroll wheel default is pan or zoom
context: Design canvases (Figma, FigJam, Miro trackpad mode, tldraw) default scroll to PAN and reserve ctrl/cmd+scroll plus pinch for zoom at the cursor. Graph viewers (React Flow default) zoom on scroll. Device sniffing is a dead end (tldraw closed it not-planned). Either way ships a small user setting (Miro precedent), so this locks only the DEFAULT.

options.label: Scroll pans; ctrl/cmd+scroll and pinch zoom

rationale: Owner locked via tray 2026-08-18: default follows the design-canvas convention (scroll pans, ctrl/cmd+scroll and pinch zoom at cursor) matching the spatial city-map metaphor; a small setting flips it per user.
